Players Committee card image of [[Quietly Observing (V)]], as first published (no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on table. Aurra, Bossk, and Cad are destiny +2. Once per game, may reveal a unique (•) alien from hand or Reserve Deck (reshuffle); for remainder of game, that card is an assassin and ignores [Reflections II] and [Theed Palace] objective deployment restrictions. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/quietlyobserving.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/quietlyobserving.gif] as of commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics” (2 August 2019).
